scope: Reserved future IDs only; not a run, not outcome analysis, not official FinQA test split
selection: SHA256 report and question with fixed20261019 salts; one question per company/year report; no outcome-based selection
forbidden_use: Do not run confirmation cases for prompt/method/model selection. Freeze final method, comparator, scoring and statistical plan before any confirmation inference.
known_limits: Public TRAIN reports may be in model pretraining; this is a held-out report split for method research, not contamination-free benchmark evidence
Company/year filename is the report grouping key, not issuer-disjointness
150cases are a reservation, not a claim of statistical power. Size may need expansion before opening outcomes based on independently planned effect/margin.
Dataset raw JSON includes annotations, but this reservation code only accesses ID/filename/question and does not extract selected outcomes.
